name: Prototype {OS}
tagline: The cheapest artifact that answers the riskiest open question.

commands.name: /prototype
commands.does: Open the OS and propose the triage from open upstream questions

commands.name: triage
commands.does: Rank open questions by cost of being wrong against cost of answering

commands.name: question <text>
commands.does: Rewrite a worry into a falsifiable question with a threshold

commands.name: spike <id>
commands.does: Throwaway implementation of the technically risky part only

commands.name: flow <id>
commands.does: Comprehension or interaction test with a fixed protocol

commands.name: fake <id>
commands.does: Demand test measuring observed behaviour, not stated intent

commands.name: bench <id>
commands.does: Reproducible measurement against a pre-agreed threshold

commands.name: verdict <id>
commands.does: Rule CONFIRMED, REFUTED or INCONCLUSIVE and name what it settles

commands.name: teardown <id>
commands.does: Delete the artifact, revoke its access, record the removal

commands.name: ledger
commands.does: Every prototype, its verdict and its expiry, live ones flagged

requires_human_approval_for: using any real customer data, even sampled or anonymised
exposing an artifact to real users, including a smoke test that collects an email or takes money
spending beyond the agreed budget ceiling for one question
keeping an artifact past its expiry date
recording a verdict that reverses an approved Blueprint decision
